Fill your Christmas party with big laughs and brave dares, and look like a pro host, with Christmas Truth or Dare: 100 printable cards in two decks, a Family & Teens deck (ages 10+) and a cheeky but clean Grown-ups deck.
It's an instant download, so you can print tonight and play tonight. Just print, cut and pick truth or dare, or spin the wheel.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
- 100 cards in 2 decks: 25 truths + 25 dares for Family & Teens (ages 10+), and 25 truths + 25 dares for Grown-ups

HOW IT WORKS
On your turn, pick Truth or Dare, or spin the wheel with a pencil and a paper clip. The player on your right reads your card out loud. Answer the truth honestly for 1 point, or do the dare for 2 points. The wheel adds Buddy Dare (you and a buddy both score 2), Round the Room (everyone answers one truth, 1 point each), You Choose and Group Chooses. Not feeling it? Hand in a pass token to skip the card, no questions asked (a pass scores 0). Most points wins; tied players each do one more dare and the group votes for the best. Truths print on the left and dares on the right of every page, so the piles sort themselves as you cut.

TWO DECKS FOR EVERY AGE
The Family & Teens deck (ages 10+) is full of silly impressions, carol challenges and "have you ever peeked at your presents?" truths. The Grown-ups deck is cheeky but clean: reply-all mistakes, re-gifted presents and dramatic speeches, with no drinking, no dating and nothing explicit. It's clean enough for mixed company, so it works at the office party too. Every dare is indoor-safe: no food, no phones, no climbing and no leaving the room. Playing with kids under 10? Use the Family & Teens deck, a grown-up reads each card, and skip any card that doesn't suit them.

results.description:
Truth or Dare for the Christmas party: 16 truths, 16 dares, and something to do once the gift exchange is over.

The truths are holiday confessions. Have you ever regifted something, and who got it? What's the worst gift you ever pretended to love? The dares are quick bits of theater, like singing the first line of a carol as an opera singer or giving a heartfelt toast to the fruitcake. Refuse a card and the room picks a carol for you to sing one line of. No drinking, nobody leaves the room, and nothing ends in a follow-up conversation with HR.

WHAT'S INCLUDED (US Letter 8.5 x 11 PDF, 6 pages)
- Cover: NomadicForgePrintCo Christmas Truth or Dare Printable
- How to Play: four short sections covering the classic draw, the 30 second dare, the regift, and keeping it friendly
- 2 Truth sheets: 16 truth cards on cream, eight to a sheet
- 2 Dare sheets: 16 dare cards on a dark background, eight to a sheet

A single PDF that downloads instantly.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Order it and download the PDF.
2. Print it on US Letter paper at true size, front side only. It looks best in color, but grayscale prints read clearly.
3. Cut on the dashed lines and make two stacks, one for truths and one for dares.
4. When it's your turn, say Truth or Dare before anyone reads the card. Answer it, act it out, or sing your carol line. Then the turn passes to your left.
5. For extra fun, the host gives each dare 30 seconds and the room claps for a winner. Best dare of the night picks first from the cookie tray. Each player gets one "regift" per game to swap a card they drew for one off the other stack. Hand it back with a bow if you have one. Expect 10 to 25 minutes for a game.

You'll need a printer, scissors, a timer, and a room full of people.

WHO IT'S FOR
